vo.en: Quick, name a vegetable right now!

visual.description: A man pointing intensely directly at the camera with an energetic expression.

vo.en: Don't blink. I’m hacking your subconscious in ten seconds using a technique called psychological priming.

visual.description: Fast-paced digital glitch effects and abstract data streams flickering on a dark background.

vo.en: Visualize the color blue. Deep blue ocean waves, a bright blue sky, and flashing blue neon signs.

visual.description: Cinematic shots of crashing deep blue ocean waves followed by neon blue lights.

vo.en: Wait until you see the result, because your brain is currently trapped in a massive logic loop.

visual.description: A hypnotic spinning spiral in high contrast black and white or deep blue.

vo.en: I’m counting down from three. Three, two, one... Say the first vegetable that hits your mind!

visual.description: A high-tech digital countdown timer ticking down rapidly on a dark screen.

vo.en: You just thought of a Carrot. Your brain bypassed unique options and defaulted to the standard archetype.

visual.description: A close-up shot of a bunch of fresh orange carrots with green tops on a wooden table.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow's brain test and comment YES if I caught you... which is exactly why...

visual.description: A close-up of a hand tapping a smartphone screen to hit a subscribe button and notification bell.
